nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances; credited by _mint, debited by _transfer and _burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by _approve and consumed by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the ERC20 constructor.
Constructor of MILF; calls ERC20 constructor and mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
Internal mint: validates zero address, adds to _totalSupply and _balances[account], emits Transfer.
Internal transfer: zero-address checks, calls _beforeTokenTransfer, then SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
External transfer wrapper delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
External transferFrom: moves tokens then decreases allowance via _approve.
External approve wrapper delegating to _approve for _msgSender().
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks; writes _allowances[owner][spender].
Atomically increases spender allowance via SafeMath.add and _approve.
Atomically decreases spender allowance via SafeMath.sub and _approve.
Internal burn: validates account, decrements _balances[account], decrements _totalSupply.
Returns msg.sender; used as the authenticated caller identity throughout ERC20.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn; overridable callback point.
Checked addition with overflow require; used for balances and total supply increases.
Checked subtraction with underflow require; used for balances, allowances and supply decreases.
Caller-controlled address; used as mint beneficiary at deployment and as caller identity in transfers/approvals.
_mint(msg.sender, 10e28) executed in the MILF constructor; creates 1e29 base units for msg.sender.
_balances[sender].sub(amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance") inside _transfer.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance") inside transferFrom.
_totalSupply.sub(amount) inside _burn, reducing the circulating supply.
_totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint, increasing the supply.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer/_mint/_burn and allowance amounts.
address recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
address sender parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
address spender parameter of approve/_approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
address account parameter of balanceOf/_mint/_burn.
uint256 c local result inside SafeMath add/sub/mul computations.

edges.reason: MILF constructor invokes ERC20._mint to create the initial token supply.
The initial supply mint operation is executed by calling _mint(msg.sender, 10e28).
msg.sender is the recipient of the initial mint, so whoever deploys the contract receives the entire supply.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the mint beneficiary without any access restriction.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint performs the total supply addition operation.
The checked addition result is written into the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint relies on SafeMath.add for overflow-safe supply and balance arithmetic.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for underflow-safe balance arithmetic.
The balance subtraction operation is executed inside _transfer.
transfer delegates all token movement to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom delegates token movement to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the caller's allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to the internal _approve function.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
_transfer reads and rewrites the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
The allowance subtraction operation is performed inside transferFrom.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the increased allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decreased allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub to compute the new allowance.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub on both the account balance and the total supply.
The total supply subtraction operation is executed inside _burn.
_burn debits _balances[account] and thereby mutates balance state.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer virtual hook before mutating balances, an overridable callback point.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to the calling function.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner/spender in the _approve call.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries value into the _transfer balance arithmetic and has no independent role.
The recipient parameter feeds directly into the _balances[recipient] credit inside _transfer.
The sender parameter feeds directly into the _balances[sender] debit inside _transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the _allowances key written by _approve.
The account parameter is the destination of the minted balance update in _mint.
The local c is the transient arithmetic result computed inside SafeMath.add.
